rules.description: The home timeline (For you, Following) and Explore. Writing a post still works; profiles, search, notifications and single posts are left alone.
rules.notes: X serves two web clients. The first replace selector and the hide selector (the 'new posts' pill) belong to the classic one. The second replace selector belongs to the rewritten client, whose home timelines carry ids such as urt:home:for-you.

rules.description: "Today's News" and "What's happening" in the side column, on every page. The search box and "Who to follow" stay.
rules.notes: Classic web client only. The side column is a list of cards; each selector takes the whole card, so no empty frame is left behind.
